Resolves #20351

The `resizeSplit GLIDES` witness no longer closes on another motion's signal:
- it waits for in-flight dock motion to settle before the sampler starts;
- it brackets the glide's own producer, the workspace FLIP (`.neo-dock-workspace` with the animating class), as the moveItem arm already does;
- the samples floor's message names `gaps`, so a future red says whether the witness ran.

Evidence: L3 (local Brain-gated e2e on a fresh bridge, 4× CPU throttling, 20 repeats per arm, no retries) → L3 required (AC-3).

Prescription checked: test-only. `DockMotionNL.spec.mjs` owns the witness, and the producer was read from `src/dashboard/dock/Workspace.mjs` (the FLIP's `MotionSignal.enter(me)`).

agent-preflight is not hosted here. These baseline checks ran instead: `check-ticket-archaeology`, `check-fixed-sleeps`, and the pre-commit hooks.

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | Diff: `test/playwright/e2e/dashboard/DockMotionNL.spec.mjs`, GLIDES arm. A settle poll runs before `startMotionSampler`, and ``expectSignalBracket(page, {selector: `.neo-dock-workspace${SIGNAL}`})`` replaces the any-element bracket |
| AC-2 | Diff: the floor's message reads `(${gaps} frames without it)` |
| AC-3 | Outside-CI: under 4× CPU throttling with `--repeat-each=20`, the fixed arm passed 20/20. The old arm on `dev` `1bb05f5426` passed 19/20 (Test Evidence) |

## Deltas from ticket

None.

## Test Evidence

**Local setup:** `NEO_NL_PORT` set to a free port (the seat's fleet Bridge holds 8081, #20339), and `NEO_AGENTOS_RUNTIME_ROOT` pointing at a Brain checkout. `Emulation.setCPUThrottlingRate` rate 4 was added by a temporary local line, which is not committed.

| Arm | Unthrottled | 4× throttled, 20 repeats |
|---|---|---|
| fixed | 3/3 | 20/20 |
| old (`dev`) | — | 19/20 |

The old arm's red read `Expected: > 2, Received: 2` distinct widths: the read saw only the before and after widths, not one frame of the glide. That is the same mechanism as the hosted `Received: 5` reds, though the exact 5-sample floor did not reproduce locally.
